title: Message arrives
body: The gateway gets a Telegram update or a Discord message.
can_fail_how: The adapter is down or the platform drops the update.
summary: The gateway gets a Telegram update or a Discord message.

title: Allow-list check
body: Only listed user ids continue. An empty list refuses everyone.
summary: Only listed user ids continue. An empty list refuses everyone.

title: Wait for the chat lock
body: Each chat or channel has one lock. A second message waits in arrival order.
can_fail_how: A long first turn delays the second message.
summary: Each chat or channel has one lock. A second message waits in arrival order.

title: Build the prompt
body: System text, tool list, memory context and recent history are put together. Long history is shortened.
can_fail_how: Very long chats are summarised with a simple text method, not by a model.
summary: System text, tool list, memory context and recent history are put together. Long history is shortened.

title: Pick a model
body: The router picks small, medium or power from the message and the settings.
can_fail_how: An empty tier falls back to the next one.
summary: The router picks small, medium or power from the message and the settings.

title: Call the model
body: The provider layer sends messages and tool schemas.
can_fail_how: The API returns an error. Fallback candidates are tried when set.
summary: The provider layer sends messages and tool schemas.

title: Tool round
body: If the model asks for tools, each is run and the results go back. The default limit is 25 rounds.
can_fail_how: At the limit the model is asked once for a wrap-up without tools.
summary: If the model asks for tools, each is run and the results go back. The default limit is 25 rounds.

title: Approval pause
body: Risky code or commands return an approval request and the turn ends.
can_fail_how: The owner does not tap. The request stays saved and can be denied or reset.
summary: Risky code or commands return an approval request and the turn ends.

title: Run approved work
body: After a button press the code or command runs with secrets filled in.
can_fail_how: A timeout or an error is reported as text.
summary: After a button press the code or command runs with secrets filled in.

title: Screen results
body: Web text is checked for injection phrasing. Output is redacted for known secrets.
can_fail_how: Pattern checks can miss new phrasing.
summary: Web text is checked for injection phrasing. Output is redacted for known secrets.

title: Split and send
body: Long replies are split to fit (Telegram 4,000 characters, Discord 1,900).
can_fail_how: Some paths still cut text blindly, such as scheduled-job sends.
summary: Long replies are split to fit (Telegram 4,000 characters, Discord 1,900).

title: Progress lines
body: Tool lines and interim text can be shown while the turn runs.
can_fail_how: Setting TOOL_PROGRESS to off hides them.
summary: Tool lines and interim text can be shown while the turn runs.

title: Turn ends
body: History is kept. Pending approvals are saved to disk.
can_fail_how: A restart clears time-boxed windows and session allows.
summary: History is kept. Pending approvals are saved to disk.
